summary: Master data analytics tailored for customer experience professionals. Join our training course to unlock the potential of data in enhancing customer interaction
lede: Data Analytics for Customer Experience Professionals helps you interpret customer data, select relevant metrics, and analyze customer journeys to uncover actionable insight. You will learn to frame CX questions, interpret feedback, and identify opportunities to reduce friction and prioritize improvements. The course gives customer experience, service, and product professionals a practical, tool-agnostic way to connect CX decisions with measurable outcomes such as loyalty, retention, and lifetime value. You will also learn to turn findings into clear recommendations, support investment decisions, and demonstrate the value of customer-focused initiatives.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly interpret customer data, design experiences, or justify CX-related investments. This course is designed for: Customer Experience (CX) managers and specialists. Customer service and contact center leaders. Customer success and account management professionals. Marketing and digital channel managers focused on customer journeys. Product managers and service designers responsible for user experience. Business analysts and data analysts supporting CX teams. CRM and loyalty program managers. Operations managers seeking to reduce customer pain points. Quality assurance and service improvement leads. Anyone who must make and justify decisions using customer data and experience metrics.
modules: Foundations of Data Analytics for Customer Experience
Customer Data Sources and CX Metrics
Mapping and Measuring the Customer Journey
Analyzing Customer Feedback and Voice of the Customer (VoC)
Segmentation and Customer Insights for CX
Dashboards and Reporting for CX Professionals
Using Analytics to Improve Service Channels and Touchpoints
Predicting Risk and Opportunity in Customer Experience
Data-Informed CX Prioritization and Business Cases
Communicating Customer Insights and Influencing Stakeholders
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of customer experience principles and some familiarity with data interpretation. No advanced data science skills are required.
